technique_name: Describe the impact of artificial intelligence on personal privacy.
description: The impact of artificial intelligence on personal privacy is two-fold. On one hand, AI can be used to protect privacy and ensure data security. On the other, it can also be used to access people's personal data without their consent. AI-driven tools such as facial recognition technology and automated data analysis are often used by corporations and even governments to track and analyze people's actions and behaviors without them knowing. This can lead to the erosion of personal privacy, as well
